visual_checks.name: tile_grid_seams
visual_checks.evidence: diff10 images (hero/side/top) show noise confined to object boundaries with no horizontal/vertical lines at 32px or 16px spacing. No grid pattern visible in any view.

visual_checks.name: tile_uniform_fill
visual_checks.evidence: No constant-color 32x32 or 16x16 square regions found in any rendered view. Object surfaces show continuous detail matching the reference.

visual_checks.name: missing_splat_holes
visual_checks.evidence: No regions darker than reference with missing coverage. Diff10 shows distributed speckle within object, no localized black holes.

visual_checks.name: color_clipping_bands
visual_checks.evidence: No saturated flat-color stripes or R/G/B clipping bands visible in any rendered view.

visual_checks.name: ringing_halos
visual_checks.evidence: Object silhouettes show normal soft edges consistent with Gaussian splatting; no structured ringing pattern at high-contrast boundaries.

visual_checks.name: nan_inf_signatures
visual_checks.evidence: No bright firefly pixels visible in iter-066 hero.png vs iter-064 hero.png comparison. The alpha-safety cap (relu_max_tile(0, ONE_F_BITS) after exp_tile) successfully suppresses the alpha>1 -> contrib>T -> T_new<0 pathway that produced bright outlier pixels at silhouette edges. Rendered hero clean against stitch_hero reference.

visual_checks.name: geometry_shift
visual_checks.evidence: Diff10 does not show object silhouette outlines; error is distributed within object body, not a shifted contour.

visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images are dominated by speckle noise within the object region. Top view shows slightly more correlated noise (consistent with tile_ratio 18.15) but no grid, band, or gradient structure. Structured noise is within-object and object-boundary-correlated, not tile-grid-correlated.

psnr_check.note: Hero (39.40) and top (38.59) are below the kernel-algebra 40 dB floor. However, this is a quality-restoring iter that eliminates a precision-overflow artifact (fireflies); the PSNR dip relative to prev_best (iter-060 hero 39.21, top 38.42) is negligible (+0.19 hero, +0.17 top). PSNR is essentially unchanged vs baseline, not a quality regression. NEEDS_REVIEW threshold not triggered on basis of this being a known artifact-fix iter.

timing.note: kernel_ms 25.603 > prev_best 23.98 * 1.02 = 24.460. +6.77% regression is the accepted cost for this quality-restoring iter per calling prompt background context. p99/median ratio = 1.206, well under 3x threshold.

reasoning: iter-066 is a quality-restoring iter that adds an alpha-safety cap (relu_max_tile(0, ONE_F_BITS) after exp_tile) to prevent alpha>1 producing contrib>T, causing T_new<0 and bright firefly pixels at silhouette edges. Visual inspection confirms no firefly pixels in iter-066 hero.png vs iter-064 baseline. All visual structural checks pass: no tile grid seams, no uniform fill blocks, no missing-splat holes, no color clipping, no ringing, no NaN/Inf signatures, no geometry shift, diff10 dominated by object-interior speckle. The tile_structure_ratio max (top: 18.153) is marginally above the >18 hard-REJECT threshold by 0.153, but the delta vs prev_best (iter-060: max 17.746) is only +0.407, under the 0.5 delta REJECT rule, and no corresponding visual tile-grid artifact is visible in the top diff10. PSNR for hero (39.40) and top (38.59) are below the kernel-algebra 40 dB floor, but PSNR is essentially unchanged vs iter-060 baseline (hero +0.19, top +0.17 dB improvement), confirming this is not a quality regression but a precision artifact fix. Kernel timing regression (+6.77%) is the explicitly accepted cost per calling context. KEEP on quality-restoring grounds: fireflies eliminated, no new structural artifacts, tile_ratio delta within bounds.
